rundown: JackJumpers beat Hawks 95-82. JackJumpers led 43-36 at the half and never looked back. The 3rd quarter decided it: JackJumpers won it 29-20.
Leading the way — Hawks: Makur Maker 21 pts; Tyler Harvey 7 ast; Johny Narkle 7 reb. JackJumpers: Josh Bannan 22 pts, 12 reb; Taran Armstrong 8 ast.
Where JackJumpers won it: they shot 51% to 44%, shot 48% from three to 41% and won the boards 37-25.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 21, 1:25 AM ET. It had Hawks 39% and JackJumpers 61%, projecting Hawks 97.7 – JackJumpers 101 (198.8 total, JackJumpers by 3.3).

Final: Hawks 82 – JackJumpers 95. Right winner: it had JackJumpers at 61%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Hawks came in with a 3% above average attack and a 4% leakier than average defense (6-10, 97.8 scored and 104.3 allowed a game over 16 games), worth about 10 and 10 games of evidence. Projected to score 97.7, they scored 82 (−15.7 points, 16% under); projected to allow 101, they allowed 95 (−6 points, 6% under).

JackJumpers came in with a 2% below average attack and a 3% stingier than average defense (9-4, 94.7 scored and 90.4 allowed a game over 13 games), worth about 9 and 9 games of evidence. Projected to score 101, they scored 95 (−6 points, 6% under); projected to allow 97.7, they allowed 82 (−15.7 points, 16% under).

The bigger miss was Hawks' scoring (-15.7 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 177 against 198.8 projected (-21.8), about the 9th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±16).

Margin: JackJumpers by 13 against JackJumpers by 3.3 projected, about the 79th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: there were no odds to check the projection against.

The result was off its normal range without being an outlier, so the flags may have played a part.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.906 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +8.5 points. It counts toward Hoops+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 94 graded Hoops+ games the algo now scales scoring ×1.017 and gives home teams -1.2 points. Team corrections so far: Hawks attack ×0.996, defense ×1.004 (5 games); JackJumpers attack ×1.000, defense ×0.992 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
